_doc: Phase 91.Y RESERVED set. SEALED: authored together with modality_dev_v1.json and before the fix, sharing no sentence, no name and no value with it. It is run ONCE, at the end, to check that the correction generalises beyond the cases it was developed against. It is never tuned against and never used to choose between candidates.
